summary: A rectangular walled courtyard featuring three tall observation towers. The thick perimeter walls are decorated with horizontal bands of contrasting materials and vertical pillars. The interior contains an open grass floor with diagonal lighting patterns.
rebuild_hints: Lay out a rectangular footprint for the main walls, leaving the center open for the courtyard.
Build the walls with horizontal stripes of white, tan, and grey blocks, adding vertical white pillars at regular intervals.
Construct three tall towers: two at the corners of one short end, and one centered on the opposite short end.
Top the towers with flat roofs made of brick blocks bordered by stone slabs, with a central glowstone block.
Decorate the interior courtyard with grass and diagonal lines of glowstone.
Note the asymmetrical raised wall section on one of the long sides.
uncertainties: Exact material IDs for the white and tan blocks (could be quartz, concrete, wool, sandstone, or wood).
Interior layout of the towers is unknown.
Purpose of the asymmetrical raised wall section.
